children: Doosan Enerbility's potential participation in a U.S. gas power plant project could expand its footprint in the global gas turbine market, say Nomura's Cindy Park and Dongmin Lee. The analysts expect the South Korean company to supply four 380-megawatt gas turbines for an initial phase of the 6.3-gigawatt gas power plant in Texas--a part of the 2025 U.S.-South Korean investment deal. They expect Doosan to secure additional gas turbine orders as the multi-phase energy project advances. Nomura maintains a buy rating and a target price of 110,000 won on the stock. Shares are 2.5% higher at 91,700 won.(kwanwoo.jun@wsj.com)
